_note: Baselined dependency advisories for the CI dependency-audit gate (issue #22). Keyed by GHSA ID. The gate fails only on critical/high advisories NOT listed here. To ACCEPT a new finding: add it with a reason + accepted_on date under security-engineer review. To mark RESOLVED: remove its entry once the dependency is bumped. Optional review_spec (the tracking spec that will resolve it) and review_by (ISO date) mark a time-boxed acceptance: past review_by the gate warns on every run and FAILS the nightly scheduled re-audit, so a slipped fix goes loud instead of silent. A review_spec with review_by:null is flagged pending until the tracking spec has a target date.

GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg.reason: DoS via unbounded brace-expansion length (OOM crash), published 2026-07-24, vulnerable <=5.0.7. The only patched version is 5.0.8, whose CommonJS build exports a named `exports.expand` instead of `module.exports = expand`. Our sole consumer is eslint's transitive minimatch@3.1.5, which does `require('brace-expansion')(pattern)` — under 5.0.8 that calls an object and breaks lint/CI. No maintenance-line backport (1.1.17/2.1.3/3.0.3) preserving the CJS API exists yet, so there is no compatible fix. Dev-only, transitive: brace-expansion is reached only through eslint glob matching, patterns come from eslint config/CLI, not attacker-controlled runtime input — no production surface.
